dataset: NASA Global Landslide Catalog (via WPRDC CKAN mirror)
task: predict fatality (fatalities>0) from pre-event features (country, trigger, category, setting, month, location); temporal split train<=2014 / val 2015-2016 / test>=2017
honest_limitations: fatal outcome depends on exposure and reporting, not only on the physical event; catalog is media-report based with strong reporting bias toward fatal events in later years
no rainfall/terrain covariates at event location are included (only country/trigger/setting/month), so this is an event-outcome screening model, not a hazard model
